label: daily-aggregation-over-binary-loki-defaults
description: An aggregation over a binary expression aggregates the whole binary (PR for semantics/aggregation-over-binary-dropped): each operand is its own VictoriaLogs stats query, the proxy joins the aggregated operand series and folds them per step. B1 is the visual page's shape (a sum by over a rate divided by a literal), B2 a sum by over a ratio of two per-stream metrics, B3 the instant `sum(2 * ...)` that answered 400, B4 the query of semantics/binary-ignoring-matching (an outer sum over `+ ignoring(machine)`). Run with the control set.
